business_definition: Number of inpatient discharge records in the selected context.
calculation_rule: COUNT_ROWS
valid_record_rule: Include all released discharge records
important_caveat: Discharge count is not a unique-patient count.

business_definition: Number of distinct nonmissing permanent facility identifiers.
calculation_rule: DISTINCT_COUNT(Permanent Facility Id)
valid_record_rule: Permanent Facility Id is nonmissing
important_caveat: Facility identifiers may be suppressed for some records.

business_definition: Total observed inpatient days after representing 120+ as 120.
calculation_rule: SUM(LOS numeric lower bound)
numerator: Sum of valid numeric LOS lower bounds
valid_record_rule: LOS is numeric or is the recognized 120+ top-coded value
important_caveat: This understates exact inpatient days because 120+ values are right-censored.

business_definition: Average numeric LOS after representing 120+ as 120.
calculation_rule: SUM(LOS numeric lower bound) / COUNT(valid LOS records)
valid_record_rule: LOS is numeric or is the recognized 120+ top-coded value
important_caveat: The result is a lower-bound mean and is sensitive to skewness.

business_definition: Median LOS after representing 120+ as its observable lower bound.
calculation_rule: MEDIAN(LOS numeric lower bound)
valid_record_rule: LOS is numeric or is the recognized 120+ top-coded value
important_caveat: Median LOS is robust but does not replace total-days analysis.

business_definition: Ninety-fifth percentile of the observable LOS lower bound.
calculation_rule: PERCENTILE_CONT(LOS numeric lower bound, 0.95)
valid_record_rule: LOS is numeric or is the recognized 120+ top-coded value
important_caveat: The percentile may be affected when top-coded cases are included.

business_definition: Number of discharges whose released LOS is 120 days or more.
calculation_rule: COUNT(Length of Stay classified as 120+)
valid_record_rule: Length of Stay matches the confirmed top-code
important_caveat: The exact stay duration is unavailable.

business_definition: Percentage of valid LOS records that are top-coded.
calculation_rule: Top-coded LOS discharges / discharges with valid LOS
valid_record_rule: Use records with valid released LOS
important_caveat: This measures censoring prevalence, not clinical performance.

business_definition: Total valid billed hospital charges.
calculation_rule: SUM(valid Total Charges)
numerator: Sum of valid positive Total Charges
valid_record_rule: Total Charges is numeric and greater than zero
important_caveat: Charges are not reimbursement, revenue, or audited expense.

business_definition: Average billed charge among discharges with valid charges.
calculation_rule: SUM(valid Total Charges) / COUNT(valid charge records)
valid_record_rule: Total Charges is numeric and greater than zero
important_caveat: Highly sensitive to right-skewed observations.

business_definition: Median valid billed charge per discharge.
calculation_rule: MEDIAN(valid Total Charges)
valid_record_rule: Total Charges is numeric and greater than zero
important_caveat: Charges do not measure hospital profitability.

business_definition: Total released analytical cost estimate.
calculation_rule: SUM(valid Total Costs)
numerator: Sum of valid positive Total Costs
valid_record_rule: Total Costs is numeric and greater than zero
important_caveat: Total Costs does not represent audited hospital expense.

business_definition: Average estimated cost among records with valid cost values.
calculation_rule: SUM(valid Total Costs) / COUNT(valid cost records)
valid_record_rule: Total Costs is numeric and greater than zero
important_caveat: Case-mix-adjusted cost performance is not established here.

business_definition: Median valid estimated cost per discharge.
calculation_rule: MEDIAN(valid Total Costs)
valid_record_rule: Total Costs is numeric and greater than zero
important_caveat: This is an analytical estimate—not audited expense.

business_definition: Aggregate charges divided by aggregate estimated costs.
calculation_rule: SUM(Total Charges for paired-valid records) / SUM(Total Costs for the same paired-valid records)
denominator: Total Costs among the same paired-valid records
valid_record_rule: Both Total Charges and Total Costs are numeric and positive
important_caveat: Do not calculate the mean of discharge-level charge-to-cost ratios.

business_definition: Percentage of eligible inpatient discharges associated with the emergency department indicator.
calculation_rule: ED-indicator discharges / discharges with known ED indicator
valid_record_rule: ED indicator is mapped and nonmissing
important_caveat: This should not automatically be described as avoidable ED use.

business_definition: Percentage of eligible discharges classified as emergency admissions.
calculation_rule: Emergency admissions / discharges with known admission type
valid_record_rule: Admission type is mapped and nonmissing
important_caveat: Admission mix reflects patient population and service structure.

business_definition: Percentage of discharges classified as major or extreme APR severity.
calculation_rule: Major-or-extreme severity discharges / discharges with known severity
valid_record_rule: APR severity is known and mapped
important_caveat: This is a case-mix descriptor—not an outcome metric.

business_definition: Percentage of discharges classified as major or extreme APR risk of mortality.
calculation_rule: Major-or-extreme risk discharges / discharges with known APR mortality risk
numerator: Major or extreme APR mortality-risk discharges
denominator: Discharges with known APR mortality risk
valid_record_rule: APR mortality-risk category is known and mapped
important_caveat: APR risk of mortality is not observed mortality.

business_definition: Expected total LOS based on statewide peer-group mean LOS, excluding the benchmarked facility.
calculation_rule: SUM(discharge-level leave-one-facility-out peer mean LOS)
numerator: Sum of eligible peer-expected LOS values
required_fields: Permanent Facility Id|APR DRG Code|APR Severity of Illness Code|Length of Stay
valid_record_rule: Valid LOS, facility, APR-DRG, severity, and sufficient peers
important_caveat: This is a descriptive peer baseline—not a predicted clinical LOS.

business_definition: Observed LOS days divided by peer-expected LOS days.
calculation_rule: SUM(observed LOS lower bound) / SUM(peer-expected LOS)
required_fields: Permanent Facility Id|APR DRG Code|APR Severity of Illness Code|Length of Stay
valid_record_rule: Discharges with valid observed and expected LOS
important_caveat: Unmeasured hospital structure and case-mix differences remain.

business_definition: Observed LOS days minus peer-expected LOS days.
calculation_rule: SUM(observed LOS lower bound) - SUM(peer-expected LOS)
numerator: Observed LOS days minus peer-expected LOS days
required_fields: Permanent Facility Id|APR DRG Code|APR Severity of Illness Code|Length of Stay
valid_record_rule: Discharges with valid observed and expected LOS
important_caveat: Positive excess days identify variation—not preventable days.
